title: Transport of Good Factorization to the Target
body_html:
Transport of Good Factorization to the Target

If \[ \Gamma=\sum_i\Gamma_i \] is a GL-good factorization and \(w\) realizes \(M(w)=\Gamma\), then \[ \Gamma_i'=w\Gamma_iw^{-1} \] are elements of the target Lie algebra, and \[ \Gamma'=M'(w)=\sum_i\Gamma_i' \] is a GL-good factorization on the target side.
proof_html:
Extraction

The adjoint relation and \(w^\ast w=\Gamma\) show \((w\Gamma_iw^{-1})^\ast=-w\Gamma_iw^{-1}\), so each transported factor is in \(\mathbf g'\). Since \(w\) is a \(D\)-linear isomorphism, root valuations and GL-goodness are preserved.
